about: Service levels of the landing loop, from the METRICS dataset (cf/scale/slo.md). slo_report.py and the alert Worker (cf/nerudo-slo) read this file. Each SLO is good events / all events; `good` and `total` are SQL expressions on the dataset.

slos.name: queue_age
slos.text: At the start of a round, the oldest queued change joined the queue at most 30 s ago.

slos.name: landing_latency
slos.text: A change lands at most 10 s after it joined the queue.

slos.name: loop_errors
slos.text: A round of the landing loop ends without an error. A CI error counts in ci_availability.

slos.name: ci_availability
slos.text: A round that calls the CI Worker gets a verdict from it. A round that waits for CI (ci = 'unavailable') or an alarm error of cause ci is a bad event.
slos.total: sumIf(_sample_interval, (blob1 = 'round' AND blob2 IN ('passed', 'failed', 'trunk_red', 'unavailable')) OR (blob1 = 'alarm_error' AND blob2 = 'ci'))

alerts.name: page
alerts.text: Fast burn: at this rate, 1 hour uses about 2% of the 28-day error budget

alerts.name: ticket
alerts.text: Slow burn: at this rate, 6 hours use about 5% of the 28-day error budget
